880-3678-8345.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
880-3678-8345.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed.
When the land enters the battlefield, Retreat to Emeria triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

678-5147-5865.notablePrerequisites: An opponent has lost life this turn
678-5147-5865.description:
Cast Flamecache Gecko by paying its mana cost.
When Flamecache Gecko enters, it triggers, adding {B}{R}.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Flamecache Gecko.
When Flamecache Gecko dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Flamecache Gecko from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

1879-3755-4770-6090.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it and Arahbo trigger.
Resolve the Arahbo trigger, creating a 1/1 Cat creature token.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Cat token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

512-950-1129.easyPrerequisites: Harabaz Druid and Fatestitcher do not have summoning sickness.
512-950-1129.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Allies.
512-950-1129.description:
Activate Harabaz Druid by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}
Activate Fatestitcher by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Fatestitcher and Harabaz Druid, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Fatestitcher ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
512-950-1129.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Harabaz Druid's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

512-5475-6478.easyPrerequisites: Arbor Adherent and Forensic Researcher do not have summoning sickness.
512-5475-6478.description:
Activate Arbor Adherent by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}{W}
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Forensic Researcher and Arbor Adherent, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Forensic Researcher ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
512-5475-6478.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Arbor Adherent's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2074-4247-6972.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Vorapede
When Vorapede dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Vorapede
When Vorapede dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve both Bloodthrone Vampire abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
2074-4247-6972.notes: If Vorapede starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

997-6972-7933.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Cold-Blooded Crew.
When Cold-Blooded Crew dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Cold-Blooded Crew enters, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

3113-3459-7839.description:
Activate Battered Golem using the ability granted to it by Fire Whip by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to Smaug.
Smaug triggers, creating a Treasure token.
When the Treasure enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

45-129-1978-5793.description:
Activate Khalni Gem by tapping it, adding two mana.
Kinnan triggers, adding at least one additional mana.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Khalni Gem which is an artifact creature due to Bello. 
Repeat any number of times.

requires.n: Land that adds at least two mana

343-4019-4221--85--172.description:
Play the land that taps for multiple mana.
That land enters as a creature due to Living Plane, triggering Vigean Graftmage's Graft ability, allowing you to move a +1/+1 counter from Vigean Graftmage to that land.
Activate that land by tapping it, adding at least two mana.
Regal Behemoth triggers, adding at least one additional mana.
Activate Vigean Graftmage by paying {1}{U}, untapping the land creature.
Repeat.
343-4019-4221--85--172.notes:
Note that either the land or the additional mana source must add blue mana.

If the land adds at least {2}{U}, the additional mana source is not necessary.

You may wait a turn after playing the land instead of using the haste enabler.

475-549-4186-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
475-549-4186-6996.description:
Gain life in any way.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Biotransference.
Leonin Elder triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

1409-3099-4289-4742.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

1619-4050-4605-5542-6153.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-4050-4605-5542-6153.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Vicious Battlerager from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Vicious Battlerager enters, it and Preston trigger twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Vicious Battlerager.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Vicious Battlerager that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Vicious Battlerager token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Vicious Battlerager token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Vicious Battlerager that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the first Vicious Battlerager trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-4050-4605-5542-6153.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

1170-3363-5078-7729.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {1}.
The Vision and Scarlet Witch and Displacer Kitten trigger.
Resolve the Vision and Scarlet Witch trigger, adding {R} and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking The One Ring.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Activate The One Ring by tapping it, putting a burden counter on it and causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3185-6797-6972.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Evernight Shade
When Evernight Shade dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Evernight Shade
When Evernight Shade dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Evernight Shade enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness. Its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 4.
3185-6797-6972.notes: If Evernight Shade starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 4 instead.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

4184-5231-6972.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Relentless Skaabs
When Relentless Skaabs dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Relentless Skaabs
When Relentless Skaabs dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Repeat.
4184-5231-6972.notes: If Relentless Skaabs starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

677-2438-4217-5211.easyPrerequisites: You control at least five lands.
677-2438-4217-5211.description:
Cast Brass's Bounty by paying {6}{R}.
Holding priority, cast Lutri by paying {1}{U/R}{U/R}.
When Lutri enters, it triggers, copying Brass's Bounty.
Resolve the copy of Brass's Bounty, creating a Treasure token for each land you control.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Lutri.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Lutri from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 3.
677-2438-4217-5211.notes: You can start the combo instead at step 7 if Lutri is in your graveyard. This changes the mana needed to {6}{W}{U}{B}{R}{R}{G}.

uses.n: Valentin, Dean of the Vein // Lisette, Dean of the Root

2034-3097-3490-7286.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, South Wind Avatar's first ability triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Lisette and South Wind Avatar's second ability trigger.
Resolve the South Wind Avatar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Lisette trigger, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers for each counter placed this way.
Resolve the first trigger, choosing to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve all other triggers, choosing not to pay.
Repeat.

3875-4826-5702-6973.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
3875-4826-5702-6973.description:
Play a land.
When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Mutable Explorer.
When the Mutable Explorer token enters, it triggers, creating a Mutavault land token that enters untapped due to Archelos.
When the Mutavault token enters, Springheart Nantuko and Tireless Provisioner trigger.
Holding priority, activate the Mutavault token by tapping it, adding {C}.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Holding priority, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Mutable Explorer.
Repeat from step 3.

486-1978-5614.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 3 or greater.
486-1978-5614.description:
Cause Bighorner Rancher to become an artifact using Liquimetal Torque.
Activate Bighorner Rancher by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Bighorner Rancher.
Repeat from step 2.

2438-3652-5220-6900.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Ornithopter
When Ornithopter dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Ornithopter from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Cast Ornithopter from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

2034-3755-5220.easyPrerequisites: You control another nontoken creature that can be cast using {C}{C} or less.
2034-3755-5220.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the nontoken creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

997-2906-4484-4871-5643.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
997-2906-4484-4871-5643.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents have lost at least 2 life this turn.
997-2906-4484-4871-5643.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Woe Strider twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Woe Strider abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
997-2906-4484-4871-5643.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

uses.battlefieldCardState: is a creature without summoning sickness

478-539-1526--111.description:
Activate Circle of Dreams Druid by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Candelabra of Tawnos by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping it and Circle of Dreams Druid.
Repeat.

628-5231-6487.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Canker Abomination, adding {R}.
When Canker Abomination dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Canker Abomination enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a number of -1/-1 counters on it equal to the number of creatures an opponent controls.
If the opponent had seven or more creatures, Canker Abomination will die as a state-based action due to having 0 or less toughness. If this occurs, repeat steps 2 through 4 infinitely.
Otherwise, repeat from step 1.

1887-4120-4968.easyPrerequisites: Deathbringer Thoctar has a +1/+1 counter on it.
1887-4120-4968.description:
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter on it, targeting itself, but putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Vigor.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter on it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
1887-4120-4968.notes: You may also target your other creatures in step 2 to put +1/+1 counters on them due to Vigor.

2781-4875-5147-6243.easyPrerequisites: any type other than "Angel" chosen with Conspiracy.
2781-4875-5147-6243.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Felidar Guardian.
When Felidar Guardian dies, Valkyrie's Call triggers, returning Felidar Guardian from your graveyard to the battlefield as an Angel.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Conspiracy. Choose any creature type except "Angel" as Conspiracy enters the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

277-1682-5702-5954.easyPrerequisites:
Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
277-1682-5702-5954.description:
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating a tapped Everywhere land token.
When the Everywhere token enters the battlefield, Tiller Engine and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Resolve the Tiller Engine trigger, untapping Everywhere.
Holding priority, activate Everywhere by tapping it, adding {G}.
Dictate of Karametra triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a tapped Everywhere land token.
Repeat from step 3.

1395-5033-5078-5679.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one land that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {1}.
1395-5033-5078-5679.description:
Activate a land that enters the battlefield untapped by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Storm Cauldron triggers, returning the land from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Kellan and Elsha of the Infinite's prowess ability trigger.
Resolve the Elsha of the Infinite trigger, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the Kellan trigger, putting a land from your hand onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

3101-3705-4050-5465.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Squee, adding {R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {R}{R}.
Runaway Steam-Kin triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
If Runaway Steam-Kin has three or more +1/+1 counters on it, activate it by removing three +1/+1 counters on it, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

2034-3490-5532.easyPrerequisites: "Legion" chosen with Battle of Hoover Dam.
2034-3490-5532.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures.
2034-3490-5532.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Battle of Hoover Dam triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

317-1475-2438.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional modified creature with power 1 or greater.
317-1475-2438.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another modified creature with power one or greater.
When the creature dies, Mazirek and One with the Kami triggers.
Resolve the One with the Kami trigger, creating a number of 1/1 Spirit creature tokens equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Resolve the Mazirek trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder
Repeat.

372-2781-5144.manaNeeded: {4}{W}{W} plus enough mana to pay for command tax, if applicable
372-2781-5144.description:
Cast Abdel Adrian from the command zone by paying {4}{W} and command tax, if applicable.
Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, exiling Felidar Guardian and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Cast Ephemerate by paying {W}, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves and enters the battlefield, causing Felidar Guardian to return to the battlefield from exile, and triggering Abdel Adrian and Felidar Guardian's enters-the-battlefield ability.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Felidar Guardian and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian trigger, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Repeat from step 4.

283-1921-4131-4404.notablePrerequisites:
Illusionist's Bracers attached to Tawnos.
Tawnos does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least two artifact tokens.
283-1921-4131-4404.description:
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Tawnos' second ability by paying {1}{W}{U}{B}, tapping it, sacrificing two artifact tokens and exiling Corridor Monitor from your graveyard.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Tawnos' ability.
Resolve the copy of Tawnos' ability, creating a token copy of Corridor Monitor.
The Corridor Monitor token enters the battlefield, untapping Tawnos.
Resolve the second Tawnos ability, creating a token copy of Corridor Monitor.
The Corridor Monitor token enters the battlefield, untapping Basalt Monolith.
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Tawnos' first ability by paying {2} and tapping it.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Tawnos' ability.
Resolve the copy of Tawnos' ability, creating a token copy of Corridor Monitor and causing you to mill two cards.
The Corridor Monitor token enters the battlefield, untapping Tawnos.
Resolve the second Tawnos ability, creating a token copy of Corridor Monitor and causing you to mill two cards.
The Corridor Monitor token enters the battlefield, untapping Basalt Monolith.
Repeat from step 8.

1707-2818-4302-4875.notablePrerequisites:
Floating Shield attached to Bishop of Wings.
"Black" chosen with Floating Shield.
"Angel" chosen with Conspiracy.
You control an additional creature with toughness equal to one.
You have a way to deal damage to the creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
1707-2818-4302-4875.description:
Deal damage to a creature you control with toughness equal to one.
The creature dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
The creature dies as an Angel due to Conspiracy, triggering Bishop of Wings' second ability, causing you to create a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
The Spirit enters the battlefield, as an Angel due to Conspiracy, triggering Bishop of Wings' first ability, causing you to gain four life.
Last Laugh triggers, dealing 1 damage to each creature except Bishop of WIngs, as well as each player.
The Spirit dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Repeat from step 3.

964-1999-2793.notablePrerequisites: Master Transmuter does not have summoning sickness.
964-1999-2793.description:
Cast Ugin's Nexus by paying {5}.
Ugin's Nexus enters the battlefield, triggering Replication Specialist, causing you to pay {1}{U} to create a copy of Ugin's Nexus.
Exile the token copy of Ugin's Nexus due to the legend rule, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Master Transmuter by paying {U}, tapping it, and returning Ugin's Nexus to your hand, choosing not to put an artifact card from your hand onto the battlefield.
Repeat each turn.
